claim.statement: The phase-normalized correction generator has a continuous zero extension at z=0 and an exact outward interval extension on z in [0,1/32].

normalization: each phase is exp(rate*(r-32))*(r/32)^power, hence the formal frame equals B at R=32

scope.background: Schwarzschild M=1 in ingoing EF coordinates
